title: Warbringer
text:
Warbringer is an Ascendancy class for the Warrior.


== Overview ==
The Warbringer draws strength from his Karui and Ezomyte ancestry. The class improves his ability to block attacks and Break Armour, making them more vulnerable to physical damage and other damage types. He has the ability to enhance his totems to summon Ancestral Spirits and redirect incoming damage towards it, encase himself with jade to absorb damage from hits, and unleash warcries that explode corpses while ignoring their cooldowns.
